failure_summary.description: Responses selected a related entity or the wrong answer scope despite existing guidance to identify the requested type and relation.
Answers used an overlong list or an incomplete conventional name instead of the expected concise form.
A bare place-name prompt was echoed rather than resolved to the geographic relation supported by context.

patch.reasoning: Most failures repeat rules already present, so adding broader semantic-type or relation guidance would be duplicative. The uncovered answer-form issue is combining several possible examples when the clue calls for a principal answer. The bare-name case is too underspecified to justify repeating a previously rejected general rule for elliptical clues.

edits.content:
## Avoid Unrequested Alternative Lists
When context gives several possible examples but the clue calls for a principal or conventional answer, select the best-supported single item rather than synthesizing a list of alternatives. Enumerate multiple items only when the question explicitly requests a list or exhaustive set.
